cases.prompt: 我是後端工程師但沒碰過分散式追蹤（Distributed Tracing），想在明天技術選型會議前聽得懂大家在講什麼。
expectations: Provides a grouped ~25-term high-frequency vocabulary map across system layers with brief plain-language labels.
Marks and explains the 3-5 terms tied directly to the immediate selection goal first, deferring the rest.
Maintains 50% practical depth without dumping low-level protocol internals or unrequested tangents.
Ends with up to 3 fishbone-aligned gap questions stating which gap each addresses, and does NOT proactively output a Lit-Knowledge Map.

cases.prompt: 解釋一下什麼是資料庫的 MVCC，只要講到能理解為什麼讀寫不會互鎖就好，不要展開底層實作細節。
expectations: Resolves MVCC directly with plain essence, core cause-and-effect, one concrete example, and one pitfall/boundary.
Respects the explicit depth restraint and avoids low-level storage engine internals.

cases.prompt: 請輸出我目前的點亮知識圖（Lit-Knowledge Map）。
expectations: Renders the Lit-Knowledge Map only on explicit request and strictly reflects what was actually covered in-session without marking unverified topics as lit.

cases.prompt: 幫我把這段 Python script 的 SyntaxError 修好。
expectations: Fixes the code directly instead of lecturing or outputting a vocabulary map and fishbone questions.
